benchmarkDenominator.total: 55 tracked upstream paths; check.cpp has 34 top-level scenarios, 29 equivHeads subcases, 136 verify checks, and 20 verifyThrow checks; `make -r test` passes all 34 upstream scenarios after shallow submodule initialization

benchmarkDenominator.runnerStatus: passed 2026-05-22 with `make -r test` after `sudo -n dnf install -y gcc-c++ lmdb-devel libb2-devel libasan` and `git submodule update --init --depth 1 external/hoytech-cpp external/lmdbxx external/docopt.cpp`; reconfirmed 2026-05-22 after the tracked fork/branch node-id slice, after the bounded tracked diff node-id slice, after the native memStore-range tracked-node slice, and after the named-head memStore fork guard slice. benchmarkDenominator.warning: The upstream C++ runner passes locally, but native PHP parity is still partial. Native PHP tests map upstream-compatible BLAKE2s-256 hashing/key behavior, focused in-memory sparse tree update/get/delete scenarios, iterator lower/upper-bound windows, compact proof encoding/decoding, selected proof import/export, integer proof sizing, range proofs, proof-backed updates on imported partial trees, mergeProof expansion of separately imported proofs, bounded sync proof-fragment transport/import with raw-key diff reconstruction, upstream-shaped scan-time diff callbacks, deterministic small sync-fuzz convergence, leaf node-id output/reuse semantics from `saves nodeId` and `re-use leafs`, saved branch-head checkout from `fork`, unchanged-branch copy-on-write node id reuse, tracked leaf diff node ids matching upstream `Sync::diff` Added/Deleted/Changed callbacks, bounded scan/final diff node-id equality, native memStore-range node allocation for tracked writes, detached overlay forks, the named-head memStore fork guard from `memStore forking from lmdb`, and an exact WordPress snapshot root under the upstream digest.

nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Pure-PHP BLAKE2s-256 hash/key primitives plus in-memory sparse tree get/put/delete, update batching, path-independent roots, getMulti, empty-head restoration, delete bubbling equivalence, raw-key iterator windows, compact proof transport encoding/decoding, selected proof import/export, proof-size checks, raw-key range proofs, proof-backed updates against imported partial trees, mergeProof expansion between separately imported proofs, sync request/response transport, bounded sync proof fragments, witness expansion, raw-key diff reconstruction, scan-time diff callbacks, deterministic small sync-fuzz convergence, in-memory tracked leaf node-id output/reuse semantics, branch child identity, checkout/fork by saved head node id, copy-on-write unchanged branch reuse, tracked diff callbacks carrying upstream-shaped leaf node ids, memStore-range tracked node allocation for volatile detached overlays, and named-head memStore write rejection until an explicit fork detaches the head.

wordpressScenario: Authenticated local-first state sync for Playground snapshots and content databases; current fixtures/examples map ordered WordPress option/post records through raw integer keys, exact upstream-compatible BLAKE2s snapshot roots, iterator windows, compact authenticated range proofs, proof-backed updates, merged partial proofs, sync diffs that reconstruct changed post/meta snapshots, scan-time diff callbacks that match final authenticated diffs, compact rebuilds that preserve reused leaf node ids for unchanged records, saved branch-head fork checkout for old/new snapshots, tracked scan/final diffs that report identical leaf node ids for changed/deleted/added WordPress records, volatile memStore-range preview overlays for unsaved Playground edits, and named published snapshot heads that reject volatile memStore writes until a detached preview fork is created.
